description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to an Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn with Lightning Greaves attached by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn with Lightning Greaves attached by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat from step 1.
